attachments.pdfText:
HDFC BANK CREDIT CARD - MOST IMPORTANT TERMS AND CONDITIONS (MITC)
1. Fees and charges: Annual fee, joining fee, late payment charges as per schedule of charges.
2. Credit limit: The credit limit assigned to the Cardholder is communicated at the time of card issuance and may be revised by the Bank at its discretion. The Cardholder shall not exceed the credit limit.
3. Billing: An account statement is generated monthly and sent to the registered email address. The Cardholder should review the account statement and report discrepancies within 60 days.
4. Interest: Finance charges apply on revolving balances up to 3.6% per month. 5. Payment: Minimum amount due must be paid on or before the due date. 6. Lost card: report immediately. 7. Grievance redressal and Ombudsman details are available on the website.

HDFC Bank Credit Card Cardmember Agreement
This agreement governs the use of the card. The credit limit may be increased or reduced with notice. The monthly account statement is deemed accepted unless disputed. Card is the property of the Bank. Applicable law: India. Arbitration at Mumbai. Authorised signatory. For queries contact the customer care number printed on your account statement.
